text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on species distribution modeling of the Himalayan Musk Deer under future climate scenarios. Although it uses land cover as one input variable among several bioclimatic and topographic predictors, its primary objective is not land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. Instead, it models habitat suitability for a specific endangered species. The study does not predict or simulate future LULC changes; it uses static current land cover data. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion that the primary focus must be LULC prediction. Additionally, it meets the exclusion criterion of being a species-specific/ecological study unrelated to LULC prediction.)
